purpose: Separate mechanism-development cases from cases that still have no discovered execution outcome or trajectory before the ROL study.
exposure_definition: A case is exposed when an Agent or deployment method executed on it, an Official evaluation ran, or a committed result/adjudication reveals its trajectory or outcome. Selection or preregistration without execution is not by itself outcome exposure.

rol_census_correction.pre_rol_exposure: A generation started on 2026-08-10; earlier P6 operation trajectories also exist.
P6 runtime/full trajectories and Official evaluations existed before ROL.
Multiple P6 operation, replay, calibration, and Official trajectories existed before ROL.
rol_census_correction.latest_official_outcome: pass after one exact-script retry of an infrastructure-censored package-index DNS failure

research_decision.mechanism_development: Use only already exposed confirmed bad cases to diagnose and revise ROL.
research_decision.protected_evidence: Do not execute fontbakery or verticapy until the ROL mechanism and analysis policy are fixed.
research_decision.claim_boundary: The four corrected census outcomes are development evidence only and cannot estimate ROL generalization.

limitations: This is a best-available exposure audit over the listed local, committed, and Spark evidence stores. It is an evidence record, not a new execution gate or frozen contract.
